place_fields.summary: Yandahalli Lake is a small lake near Yandahalli village in the Mysuru area, described as a calm spot suitable for photography and bird watching.

planning_attributes.description: Small lakeside attraction near Yandahalli in the Mysuru area.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The lake is listed at 7P59+W8P, Yandahalli, Karnataka 570028, near Yandahalli village.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Access may involve a muddy road, so conditions can be uneven or difficult after rain.

place_fields.vibe: urban nature park around a lake
place_fields.summary: Karanji Lake is a lake in Mysuru surrounded by a nature park with a walk-through aviary, butterfly park and other visitor facilities.

planning_attributes.description: Lake and nature park maintained by the Mysuru zoological authorities, with boating and visitor facilities.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Karanji Lake was developed as a nature park and is managed by the Mysuru Zoo authority.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The Mysuru district government lists the lake 3.9 km from the railway station and 2.6 km from the suburban bus stand.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow park access rules and remain on designated visitor paths and boating areas.

place_fields.summary: Lokaranjan Aqua World Underwater Zoo is an aquarium attraction in Mysuru featuring a walk-through underwater tunnel and freshwater and marine aquatic exhibits.

planning_attributes.description: Indoor aquarium and underwater-zoo attraction on Zoo Garden Road in Mysuru.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: The attraction is at 853-n-15 Zoo Garden Road, 15b, Lokaranjan Mahal Road, Indira Nagar, Ittige Gudu, Mysuru 570010, and is accessible by auto-rickshaws, buses and taxis.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Follow the attraction's visitor instructions and stay within designated exhibit areas.
